lines.text: Rhaenyra was named heir to the Iron Throne by her own father, and for a while the realm believed it.
Her father, King Viserys, had made his lords swear to support her, but the lords of the realm still did not want a queen.
When he died, the crown went to her half-brother Aegon, and the great houses split in two.
Her supporters were called the Blacks, and Aegon's were called the Greens.
Rhaenyra's sons rode dragons into the war.
Her young son Lucerys fled across the sky, trying to escape his cousin Aemond. Aemond chased him down on Vhagar, the largest dragon of all.
Lucerys fell, and his dragon fell with him.
Grief and rage spread through every castle in Westeros. Dragons began falling from the sky, and their riders died with them.
Rhaenyra wanted vengeance, and the houses answered her with fire and blood.
She had fought for the throne that was promised to her, and she had lost the one thing she could never replace.
Now that throne would cost her everything, and the Dance of the Dragons would burn the realm to the ground.
